annotations.description: Kept a 7-card hand with 3 Swamps and no blue mana sources, despite 3 of 4 spells requiring blue mana (Artificer's Epiphany, Launch Mishap, Whirler Rogue). Only Phyrexian Broodlings is castable. The hand is effectively a 1-spell hand until Islands are drawn.
annotations.actionTaken: Kept the hand with no blue mana sources.
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan to 6 to find a hand with at least one blue source, since the deck clearly needs blue mana for most of its spells.

annotations.description: Playing Buried Ruin over Island. Both lands enter untapped and enable casting Juggernaut this turn, but Island provides blue mana for future blue spells (the hand likely contains or will draw blue cards given the deck's blue component), while Buried Ruin only produces colorless and has a marginal sacrifice ability with no artifacts in the graveyard yet.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Buried Ruin as their land for the turn
annotations.betterLine: Play Island to have access to blue mana while still being able to cast Juggernaut this turn. Save Buried Ruin for later when colored mana sources are established.

annotations.description: Chose White for Thriving Isle when there are no white cards in hand or apparent in the deck. The deck is clearly UB (blue-black), and choosing Black would allow Thriving Isle to produce either U or B, providing crucial flexibility for casting Entomber Exarch (2BB) alongside blue spells like Whirler Rogue and Launch Mishap.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose White as the second color for Thriving Isle
annotations.betterLine: Choose Black for Thriving Isle, allowing it to tap for U or B to support the UB mana base and help cast Entomber Exarch with its BB requirement.

annotations.description: Opponent is sacrificing their Phyrexian Myr token to grow Phyrexian Broodlings. Bouncing Broodlings in response with Aether Spellbomb would create a virtual 2-for-1: the token is already sacrificed as a cost, and the Broodlings returns to hand without getting the counter. The opponent has all lands tapped and can't replay it this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, letting the +1/+1 counter resolve on Broodlings (making it 3/3)
annotations.betterLine: Activate Aether Spellbomb paying {U} to bounce Phyrexian Broodlings in response to the sacrifice ability, creating a 2-for-1 since the Myr token was already sacrificed as cost. Still has 3 Mountains untapped to potentially play a land and cast Goblin Researcher or Juggernaut this turn.

annotations.description: Cast Goblin Researcher before playing a land drop. Playing a land first (e.g., Island or Mountain) would give 5 mana total, leaving 1 mana open after casting Goblin Researcher. That spare mana could activate Aether Spellbomb's draw ability ({1}, sacrifice) if needed, and is strictly better sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Goblin Researcher with 4 available mana before making a land drop.
annotations.betterLine: Play Island or Thriving Isle first, then cast Goblin Researcher, leaving 1 mana open for Aether Spellbomb's draw ability or other responses.

annotations.description: Player chose Mountain over Island when they have no blue sources on the battlefield. They have Thirst for Knowledge exiled under Goblin Researcher (requiring {2}{U}) and need blue mana to cast it. Playing Mountain provides redundant red mana with no blue cards requiring it.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Mountain as their land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Island to enable casting Thirst for Knowledge ({2}{U}) exiled under Goblin Researcher on a future attack turn, and to have blue mana available for other blue spells in the deck.

annotations.description: Blocked the 1/1 Myr Token with Goblin Researcher instead of the much more threatening 3/3 Phyrexian Broodlings. The opponent has 1 untapped land (Thriving Isle) and can sacrifice the Myr Token to Broodlings ({1} cost) to grow it to 4/4, making the block on the token pointless. Blocking Broodlings would force the opponent into a difficult choice: either lose the Broodlings in a trade or sacrifice the token to save it (but still taking damage and losing a creature).
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked the 1/1 Phyrexian Myr Token with Goblin Researcher 3/3
annotations.betterLine: Block Phyrexian Broodlings 3/3 with Goblin Researcher 3/3. This forces the opponent to either trade their growing threat or sacrifice the Myr Token to save it. Either outcome is much better than letting Broodlings through for 3 unblocked damage while wasting a block on a 1/1 token that can be sacrificed.

annotations.description: Declined to activate Aether Spellbomb to bounce the attacking 4/4 Phyrexian Broodlings. Bouncing it would remove both +1/+1 counters, forcing the opponent to recast it as a 2/2 for 3 mana. Instead, took 4 damage (going from 13 to 9) and let the Broodlings survive to continue growing. The Spellbomb was offered as a legal action, meaning the mana was available.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, taking 4 damage from the 4/4 Phyrexian Broodlings
annotations.betterLine: Activate Aether Spellbomb targeting Phyrexian Broodlings to bounce it, removing the +1/+1 counters and saving 4 life while setting the opponent back significantly on tempo

annotations.description: Player timed out and passed the turn without playing a land or casting Juggernaut. They had 5 untapped lands and a land drop remaining, easily able to play a land AND cast the 5/3 Juggernaut. Missing both actions while behind on life against a growing Phyrexian Broodlings is devastating.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed the turn, doing nothing in postcombat main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Play an Island (or Thriving Isle), then cast Juggernaut for {4} using 4 of the remaining untapped lands. This puts a 5/3 body on the board to stabilize against opponent's threats.

annotations.description: Cast Gearsmith Guardian for 5 mana, tapping out completely, when Phyrexian Reclamation costs only 1 mana and would leave 4 mana open for Launch Mishap. Gearsmith Guardian is only a 3/5 without a blue creature on board. Tapping out leaves no ability to counter opponent's next play.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Gearsmith Guardian for 5 mana, tapping out
annotations.betterLine: Cast Phyrexian Reclamation for {B}, hold up Launch Mishap (3 mana) with 1 mana to spare. This deploys a recurring value engine while maintaining countermagic. Gearsmith Guardian could be cast next turn, potentially after Whirler Rogue to get the +2/+0 bonus.

annotations.description: Attempted to activate Aether Spellbomb (likely the {U} bounce mode) without any source of blue mana among untapped lands (only Mountains and Buried Ruin available). The activation was rolled back by the game engine. The player has two Islands in hand that should be played first to enable blue mana.
annotations.actionTaken: Tried to activate Aether Spellbomb but couldn't pay the mana cost, resulting in a wasted priority window.
annotations.betterLine: Play an Island from hand first, then either activate Aether Spellbomb's bounce mode targeting Gearsmith Guardian or Phyrexian Broodlings, or cast Juggernaut for 4 mana as a blocker against the incoming threats.

annotations.description: At 7 life facing massive board pressure, the player timed out and took no action during their precombat main phase. They had an Island to play and Juggernaut (5/3 for {4}) to cast, which would provide critical offensive pressure. They also have Thirst for Knowledge exiled under Goblin Researcher, accessible if they attack with it. Missing an entire turn's worth of development at this critical juncture is devastating.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without playing a land or casting any spell.
annotations.betterLine: Play Island (getting to 6 mana), then cast Juggernaut for {4}. Attack with Goblin Researcher to access the exiled Thirst for Knowledge. This develops the board and provides offensive pressure while keeping Aether Spellbomb for emergency bounce defense.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main phase without playing a land, despite having 3 lands in hand (Island, Island, Thriving Isle) and 1 land drop remaining. At 7 life facing 4/4 Broodlings, 3/5 Guardian, and 2/2 Exarch, the player needs to reach 7 mana for Meteor Golem ASAP. Additionally, playing an Island would provide blue mana to use Aether Spellbomb's bounce ability on a threatening creature.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without playing a land or taking any action.
annotations.betterLine: Play an Island (or Thriving Isle) to advance toward casting Meteor Golem and enable Aether Spellbomb's bounce ability with blue mana. Could also consider bouncing Gearsmith Guardian or Phyrexian Broodlings with Aether Spellbomb this turn given the low life total.

annotations.description: Declined to block Goblin Researcher 3/3 with Gearsmith Guardian 3/5 despite the block being essentially free — Guardian survives at 3/2 and kills the Researcher. Not blocking takes 3 unnecessary damage AND lets the opponent play the exiled Thirst for Knowledge (since Researcher attacked), which could draw into crucial answers. The opponent has no blue mana to activate Aether Spellbomb's bounce ability.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not block, taking 3 damage and allowing Goblin Researcher to survive and enable Thirst for Knowledge.
annotations.betterLine: Block Goblin Researcher with Gearsmith Guardian. Guardian survives at 3/2, Researcher dies, no damage taken, and opponent loses access to the exiled Thirst for Knowledge.

annotations.description: At 7 life facing 11 total damage from Phyrexian Broodlings 4/4, Entomber Exarch 2/2, and Gearsmith Guardian 3/5 (which gets +2/+0 from controlling a blue creature), the only surviving block is Juggernaut blocking Gearsmith Guardian 5/5 to trade and take only 6 damage (surviving at 1 life). Blocking any other attacker results in taking 7+ damage, which is lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked a non-Guardian attacker with Juggernaut, likely taking lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Block Gearsmith Guardian with Juggernaut to trade creatures and survive at 1 life (taking only 4+2=6 damage).
